summary: 78/80 pass. Geometry holds everywhere: 32 px strips sit on the lip with no gaps, and village scenes read correctly. The round-4 fixes for peat and cave h1 work: the side rim is gone and they read as two slabs stepping down. Snow h4 no longer reads as a vent; its stripes are low contrast and only edge toward a blind. Snow treads are now white, matching the forward snow stairs. Still failing: snow stairs h1 (w2 and w3). The single near tread is fully enclosed by a light rim on three sides inside a dark outline, the pattern that failed peat and cave in round 4. The only tread division is a 1 px pale line, so at 1x on the tan road it reads as a framed white panel or box lid, not a step. The faint grain on the near tread is acceptable as frost. Top minors: (1) snow stairs have no dark riser at all, so the step read depends on pale stripes; (2) grass h4 has a grate-like stripe density, carried by its cobble road; (3) ramps at h3-h4 look stepped; (4) snow ramps are tan with no snow.
